name: obsdog
description: Find, remember, maintain, and documentify measurable knowledge in ObsDog Spaces.

interface.shortDescription: Work with measurable knowledge in four focused ways.
interface.longDescription: Four knowledge workflows for an already-authorized remote ObsDog connection or a selected local CLI library. Remote search, reads and supported writes do not require the ObsDog CLI. Review the optional Codex start hook before trusting it. Installation does not enable cloud sync or authorize capture. Setup: https://github.com/obsdoghq/skills/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md .
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ObsDog to search my selected Personal Space and measure only what is actually opened and used.
